Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，有一个老男人叫神农。神农在古代每一天看到了别的小镇人生病还是不舒服，所以他决定开始找新的药。他下一天开始爬当地的山脉，找了各种各样的植物。神农试一试每个植物，知道有什么好处。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the people’s illness, add one concrete cause to make the problem more vivid: “很多人吃了有毒的植物以后，肚子疼得很厉害。”
2. At the point where he decides to search, add his thought or a short line of speech: “神农想：‘我一定要找到能治病的植物。’”
3. When he climbs the mountains, add a simple image of the setting: “山上有很多高高的树，也开着各种颜色的花。”

ideas.reason: This gives a concrete, story-fitting reason why people were suffering.
His decision to look for medicine already clearly shows that he wants to find plants to cure illness.
This adds a simple, appropriate image of the mountain setting.
